To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the companies of the sector of woodworking machinery have in common the absence of routines to search information about the market, which is tied basically in the sales and technical assistance.

the companies of the woodworking machinery branch do not have routines of accompaniment of their environment, which makes them to be dependent from their employees to provide them with information about the demand and the market.
the companies of the branch studied are not able to develop a dynamic capability, due to the absence of a strategic vision of the market.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of the information search and decision-making processes of companies of the woodworking machinery branch in Brazil.
the fact that the companies’ decision-making is based on the information that they have, and not on the information that is necessary.
the absence of routines of strategic management in the companies studied, which is a characteristic of small and medium sized companies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the studied companies do not have a systematic procedure to search information that allows them to make decisions in a proactive way.
the companies of this branch are not able to adapt its productive structure to the requirements of a dynamic market.

the companies’ decision-making process are not based on the analysis of the environment and on a strategic vision of the firm, but on the analysis of their own productive resources, in a standard of reactive and short term behavior.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the companies’ capability of adaptation is tied with the quality of information that they obtain and the way they are used in the decision-making processes.

the firms are incapable to develop a strategy for the development of new machines, and the decisions are taken based on the information that the market provides, in a reactive way, which is not enough to assure the firms’ competitiveness in the long term.

the studied companies have a low level of capability for the development of new competitive products, due to the absence of routines of accompaniment of market evolution, neither of competitors nor of customers.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the companies of the branch of woodworking machinery do not adopt routines of search and evaluation of information about the market, which are essential to develop new products and to maintain their competitiveness in the market.
there are no routines of search of information about the market in which the companies operate, neither about the evolution of the demand, neither about the market and competitors.
the companies of the branch of woodworking machinery have a reactive posture to the market.
